subject: [PATCH v4 10/11] mm, swap: defer memcg_table allocation for physical swap clusters

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch optimizes memory allocation for swap clusters by deferring the allocation of a memcg table until it's actually needed. This is done to reduce unnecessary memory usage in cases where a physical swap cluster only holds vswap backings, which don't require a memcg table. The patch allocates the table eagerly for vswap clusters and for physical clusters when vswap is disabled or not enabled. Otherwise, allocation is deferred until the first direct-use slot is handed out.
